source: Original image generation editing the approved M19 atlas and guided by the original user character sheet.
generation_edit_mode: referenced_image_paths=[M19 atlas, original user sheet]; transparent_background=true

reference_assets.description: Original user-provided lantern hero reference sheet

visible_bounds_measurement: Read-only connected alpha components threshold alpha>8. Regions add about3sourcepixels of padding; the cape region reaches the source right edge, whose last column contains no alpha>32. No source image pixels were edited.
pivot_measurement: Reviewed anatomical landmarks registered from the M19 source onto corresponding M20 part silhouettes, rounded to source pixels. Head anchor remains at lower metal base; collar and shin have dedicated source crops.
changes: Cleaner gently antialiased contours with simpler broad navy/plum shadow shapes.
Reduced scratch texture and noisy interior marks; crisp controlled cream and amber highlight shapes.
Preserved approved lantern silhouette, asymmetrical hook, hanging ornaments, scarf pattern, dark cloth body and short proportions.
Ivory palm has a broad readable silhouette and remains visibly separate from the dark forearm.
Assembled reference tile depicts two ivory hands for rig layering guidance.

head.anchor_kind: lower lantern metal base / neck attachment

scarf.anchor_kind: wrapped collar center; full source includes long tail

scarf_collar.anchor_kind: collar-only runtime crop, omits long hanging tail below source y658

upper_arm.anchor_kind: rounded shoulder; crop omits lower black fingers

upper_arm_full_source.use: source reference only; omit lower dark fingers when rendering the ivory forearm-hand

forearm_hand.anchor_kind: elbow at upper dark sleeve; ivory palm and fingertips continue below

shin.anchor_kind: knee; full source includes the small bent ankle/foot

shin_only.anchor_kind: knee; runtime crop omits existing source foot to allow one separate articulated foot

pendant.anchor_kind: top ribbon; optional because head already includes two hanging ornaments

assembled_reference.use: visual design reference only, not rendered together with the articulated rig

runtime_notes: Use the same atlas parts for every pose; no per-pose palette or model swap.
Use scarf_collar instead of full scarf if the cape already provides long cloth tails.
Use shin_only with a separate foot to avoid double footwear.
Use upper_arm cropped region with forearm_hand to avoid a second dark hand.
The head already includes two hanging ornaments; extra pendant rendering is optional, not automatic.
Both ivory hands must be kept readable through draw order or cape opening; the far hand should not be fully hidden behind the cape.
Keep the generated PNG unchanged. Native Godot AtlasTexture source regions perform runtime cropping.
The assembled reference tile is not a second on-screen character.
